name: Placerville
seo_title: Placerville Christmas Events for Kids 2026: 5 Events, 1 Free
seo_desc: Christmas events for kids in Placerville, California for 2026 including Apple Hill farms: 5 family events, 1 free, with dates, times and addresses checked on each host's site.
lede: Placerville pairs a Main Street tree lighting and parade with Santa visits and tree lighting at Apple Hill farms.
celebrates: Historic downtown Placerville hosts the Hometown Holiday Tree Lighting at 385 Main Street and the Hangtown Christmas Parade on Sunday, December 6. Up the hill in the Apple Hill area, Delfino Farms holds Christmas on the Farm and its 3rd annual Tree Lighting, Harris Family Farm hosts Santa visits at its choose and cut tree farm, and Apple Ridge has Santa visits the weekend after Thanksgiving. Cameron Park, Shingle Springs and Diamond Springs families join in on the same events.
lastyear: The Apple Hill Growers Association has run since 1964, and Delfino Farms has been a member since the association started, according to Edio Vineyards. Delfino's Tree Lighting was extended into an all day Christmas on the Farm celebration this year, its third annual.
facts: Placerville is nicknamed Hangtown, and the Hangtown Christmas Parade is organized by Hangtown Christmas Parade, Inc. The Apple Hill Growers Association was founded in 1964, and its Christmas tree season runs into December.
trains: No Christmas train runs in Placerville itself. The Sacramento page covers the Polar Express train ride at the California State Railroad Museum, and the River Fox Train in West Sacramento runs a Magical Christmas Train from November 27 to December 24, 2026.
train_links: Home of the Polar Express train ride covered on our Sacramento page.

faq: When is the Hangtown Christmas Parade in 2026?
Sunday, December 6, 2026, at 1 pm on Main Street in Placerville. It is free to watch.
Where can kids meet Santa in Placerville?
Santa visits Apple Ridge from November 27 to 29 and Harris Family Farm on November 28, 29 and December 5 from 11 am to 2 pm. Delfino Farms also has Christmas on the Farm on November 28.
Are there free Christmas events in Placerville?
The Hometown Holiday Tree Lighting and the Hangtown Christmas Parade are free community events. The Apple Hill farm listings do not print a price.
Can we cut our own tree near Placerville?
Harris Family Farm is a choose and cut Christmas tree farm that takes reservations through its site.
intro_html:
Rally the corgi has sniffed out the best Christmas events for kids in Placerville for 2026, and here is what he found: 5 family events, 1 of them free. The magic runs from November 27 (Santa Visits Apple Ridge) through December 6 (Hangtown Christmas Parade), with Delfino Farms Christmas on the Farm (November 28), Harris Family Farm Santa visits (November 28, 29 and December 5) and the Hometown Holiday Tree Lighting along the way. We check every date on the host's own website, and each listing links straight there.

What Rally found in Placerville

  • 5 Christmas events for kids in Placerville and nearby Apple Hill
  • 1 free event: the 48th Annual Hangtown Christmas Parade (December 6)
  • Meet Santa: Harris Family Farm (November 28, 29 and December 5) and Apple Ridge (November 27 to 29)
  • Tree lightings: the Hometown Holiday Tree Lighting on Main Street and Christmas on the Farm and Tree Lighting at Delfino Farms (November 28)
  • Season: November 27 to December 6
